title: Restore IP Addresses
description:
Insert three dots to form every valid four-part IPv4 address, with each part from 0 to 255 and no leading zero unless the part is `0`. Return addresses in lexicographic order.

## Examples

### Example 1

```text
Input: s = "25525511135"
Output: ["255.255.11.135","255.255.111.35"]
```

### Example 2

```text
Input: s = "0000"
Output: ["0.0.0.0"]
```

### Example 3

```text
Input: s = "101023"
Output: ["1.0.10.23","1.0.102.3","10.1.0.23","10.10.2.3","101.0.2.3"]
```

## Constraints

- 1 <= s.length <= 20
- s consists of digits only.
